data.rationale: The proposal gets the Careers → Openings → Country/Team/Time Type filters → Search → job → Apply sequence right and in order, but it fixes the last step as 'APPLY NOW' when the true workflow has an 'action' parameter (open or save). It also adds a keyword parameter the true workflow doesn't have and never names the target job as a parameter, so an automation would need small changes.
